mapping_limitations: East/cool and west/warm design families are established. Some exact bay indices remain unverified; relative order of three west banks is supported by continuous Bracons2015 and Smiley2023 panoramas. Do not claim a full exact inventory.
All photos predate current date and establish persistent artwork patterns, not current construction conditions.
Human-created original reference images, no generated imagery.
Sculpture photos supply visible-front reference, not calibrated multiview photogrammetry; reverse surfaces and metric offsets remain interpretation.

Three different warm-side banks have corroborating photographs: red bank (Alikhan2022 + Mortel6), Ribeiro2014_3 centre bank, greener bank immediately right (Smiley2023_3 + Bracons2015). Any composite must identify the source per aperture; unseen surfaces must remain flagged.
No paid asset purchases, authentication changes, or GPU jobs performed. No external publication had been performed when this original research record was prepared.
Ospingou2022 depicts a different pointed-lancet/16-petal opening geometry; it must not be mapped to the aisle capsule/12-petal template.
Hisgett2011 and Ribeiro2014_1 are the same bank, with bottom-left pane glazed in 2011 and boarded in 2014. Current state of that pane has not been verified.

authorship_sources.supports: Sotoo authorship of four Nativity doors, Musician Angels and singing children. Does not justify assigning all Nativity sculptures to Sotoo.
Identifies Jaume Busquets with Nativity and Annunciation groups, describes Hope/Charity/Faith portals left to right and sculpture sequence.
Josep Maria Subirachs Passion sculptural programme; contemporary work separately distinguished from Nativity artists.
